settings.content: Official CAVIERA artwork ships bundled with the theme and is used automatically wherever the mark appears. Upload a file below only to override a specific placement — it is never required. See docs/official-brand-asset-audit.md.

settings.label: Full wordmark — on light backgrounds
settings.info: Used in the header, footer and formal closing moments. Proprietary artwork — never typeset. Uses the approved bundled wordmark until you override it here.

settings.label: House Seal — on light backgrounds
settings.info: The angular oryx-head mark. Used in the mobile header, compact sticky header and small formal moments. Uses the approved bundled seal until you override it here.

settings.label: Master signature — on light backgrounds
settings.info: Official angular House Seal + proprietary CAVIERA JEWELS signature, in the exact relative composition used in the House guidelines. Never retype or recreate. Used for the homepage closing signature, The House page and the password page.

settings.label: Full-body oryx (Living Mascot)
settings.info: Editorial storytelling only — The House page, packaging story. Never a logo, never on every page.

settings.label: Walking oryx animation (WebP/GIF)
settings.info: Optional. Reserved for the ceremonial loader once approved — see the Motion section below. If absent, the loader uses its documented static-fallback framework.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Square, at least 256×256px. No approved favicon file exists yet — this setting is ready but still requires a dedicated icon file from the House. Falls back to a safe blank icon if left empty; never a broken icon request.

settings.label: Caviera Cinnabar
settings.info: Recognition — used sparingly, for the one element that should draw the eye first.

settings.label: Warm Bone
settings.info: Editorial relief — the theme's primary light surface.

settings.label: Obsidian
settings.info: Depth and theatre — the theme's primary dark surface.

settings.label: Brushed Rhodium
settings.info: Fine dividers and restrained accents only — never a dominant fill.

settings.content: The CAVIERA wordmark is artwork, never a typeface. These settings govern editorial and interface type only.

settings.label: Display font (headlines)
settings.info: Page and section headings, editorial statements. The wordmark itself is never typeset in this or any font.

settings.label: Body / interface font
settings.info: Navigation, prices, labels, forms, buttons and body copy.

settings.content: Structural controls. Large changes here affect every page — adjust with care.
Applies everywhere the shared product card appears — homepage grids, collections, search results and recommendations — so it always looks the same across the store.

settings.label: Show second image on hover
settings.info: Desktop only — touch devices never depend on hover.

settings.label: Enable quick add
settings.info: Adds directly for single-variant products; sends multi-variant products to the product page to choose.

settings.label: Title line clamp
settings.info: Visual only — the complete title always remains in the page for accessibility and search.

settings.label: Sticky add-to-bag bar (mobile)
settings.info: Appears only once the main purchase form scrolls out of view.

settings.label: Use cart drawer
settings.info: When off, the cart icon links directly to the cart page instead.

settings.label: Show shipping progress message
settings.info: Only enable once a real, currently-valid free-shipping threshold is configured below — never left on with an invented promise.

settings.label: Free-shipping threshold (in shop currency)
settings.info: Only used when the message above is enabled. 0 disables the calculation safely.

settings.label: Enable predictive search
settings.info: When off, the search icon links to the standard search results page instead of opening the overlay.

settings.content: The country/language selector itself is a Shopify Markets feature and appears automatically wherever it's enabled below, but only once the store has more than one market or language configured in Settings → Markets. Turn it on per placement: Header section → "Show country/language selector"; Footer section → "Show country/language selector"; the mobile menu follows the header's setting automatically. There is nothing to configure here — this section exists so the controls are easy to find.

settings.label: Enable interface motion
settings.info: Scroll reveals, hover transitions, menu/drawer animation. Reduced-motion visitors always get instant transitions regardless of this setting.

settings.content: The approved 2026 walking-Oryx video (assets/caviera-loader-oryx-2026.mp4) is the one loading language used site-wide for genuine internal page-to-page navigation (e.g. the full-screen menu to The House, Journal, Craftsmanship, and similar) — never for scrolling, menus, accordions, or quick actions. It appears only while a navigation is genuinely still loading and is dismissed the moment the destination is ready, never held open to let the video finish. Background colour, timing and reduced-motion behaviour are fixed as approved and are no longer separately configurable here.

settings.label: Enable loader
settings.info: Turn off to skip the loader entirely — internal navigation then behaves as plain, un-intercepted browser links.
